body.title: Jac Verse – Learn • Practice • Success
body.content:
Jac Verse is an independent educational platform created to help students, especially JAC Board students.

Our Mission

To make education easier, accessible, and free for students.

What We Offer

  • Study Notes
  • MCQs
  • Previous Year Questions
  • Question & Answers
  • Formula Library
  • Self Tests
  • Class 9 & 10 Study Materials

Our Goal

To help every student learn, practice, and succeed.

Jac Verse is not affiliated with any government organization, JAC, JCERT, or NCERT.

Made for Students, Built for Learning.

body.title: Contact Us – Jac Verse
body.content:
Have any questions, suggestions, or feedback?

You can contact us for:

  • Website Issues
  • Incorrect Study Materials
  • Content Corrections
  • Suggestions
  • Copyright Concerns

Email: jvhelp1@gmail.com

We will try to respond as soon as possible.

Thank you for supporting Jac Verse!

body.title: Privacy Policy – Jac Verse
body.content:
• Jac Verse does not require users to create an account.
  • We do not ask for personal information to access study materials.
  • Technical information may be processed by our hosting provider.
  • If you contact us, we may receive your email address.
  • Browser storage may be used to save website preferences.
  • Third-party services may use cookies.
  • External websites have their own privacy policies.
  • We take reasonable steps to protect information.
  • This policy may be updated when necessary.

For privacy questions:
Email: jvhelp1@gmail.com

body.title: Terms & Conditions – Jac Verse
body.content:
• Jac Verse is an independent educational platform.
  • All resources are provided for educational purposes.
  • Users may use materials for personal study.
  • Copying or redistributing original content without permission is prohibited.
  • Misuse of the website is not allowed.
  • We may update or remove content when necessary.
  • We do not guarantee examination results.
  • Users should verify important information with official textbooks.
  • Third-party websites follow their own terms and policies.
  • By using Jac Verse, you agree to these terms.

Email: jvhelp1@gmail.com
